timeline.retiming: Only native published cues/wordCues or project cueTimes/shotPlan; this bridge never derives semantic timestamps or redistributes internal events.

capabilities.reference_fidelity: Original package/project renderer and original inputs retained; wrapper does not rewrite motion/layout. New inputs need existing preview gates.
capabilities.replacement: Only fields declared by the selected exact workflow; native and project inputs remain separate.
capabilities.semantic_retiming: No automatic rewrite. Supply real full-audio sentence/word evidence and all required internal cues; current renderer retains capacity/order/phase gates.
capabilities.hd: Existing native/project profiles only; no new HD export verified by this sidecar.
capabilities.audio: Original full narration + independent music/source receipts required for production; no new listening claim.
capabilities.distribution: Public metadata/adapters only. Personal .motion, envelopes, restricted fonts and private media excluded.
capabilities.redistribution: adapter source only; original template core excluded; independent public closure remains separate candidate

structural.method: Exact two-package support, eight targeted adapter tests including native parameter-relative evidence resolution, real B6 schema/bindings/freeze
structural.scope: 完整声音/同源真实字幕/原包及helper精确SHA

visual.method: Original declared gallery actual viewing plus new actual native previews/full encoding
visual.scope: 原生材质、字体、内部动作、论证对应分项

audio.scope: 原声音主钟，不拉伸、不用参考测试音代替

timeline.retiming: Only native published cues/wordCues or project cueTimes/shotPlan; this bridge never derives semantic timestamps or redistributes internal events.

capabilities.reference_fidelity: Original package/project renderer and original inputs retained; wrapper does not rewrite motion/layout. New inputs need existing preview gates.
capabilities.replacement: Only fields declared by the selected exact workflow; native and project inputs remain separate.
capabilities.semantic_retiming: No automatic rewrite. Supply real full-audio sentence/word evidence and all required internal cues; current renderer retains capacity/order/phase gates.
capabilities.hd: Existing native/project profiles only; no new HD export verified by this sidecar.
capabilities.audio: Original full narration + independent music/source receipts required for production; no new listening claim.
capabilities.distribution: Public metadata/adapters only. Personal .motion, envelopes, restricted fonts and private media excluded.
capabilities.redistribution: adapter source only; original template core excluded; independent public closure remains separate candidate

structural.method: Exact two-package support, eight targeted adapter tests including native parameter-relative evidence resolution, real B6 schema/bindings/freeze
structural.scope: 完整声音/同源真实字幕/原包及helper精确SHA

visual.method: Original declared gallery actual viewing plus new actual native previews/full encoding
visual.scope: 原生材质、字体、内部动作、论证对应分项

audio.scope: 原声音主钟，不拉伸、不用参考测试音代替
